escalations.why: compare.run_claims takes charts: Sequence[Chart] with Chart owned by viz (viz.Chart), but CONSTRAINTS.md boundaries allow compare -> evaluate only and the import-linter layers contract makes compare and viz independent siblings; lint-imports confirms 'rllab.compare is not allowed to import rllab.viz' (also under TYPE_CHECKING). The interface cannot freeze this signature within CR-24. Options: type the parameter as charts: Sequence[Path] (run_claims only links each chart by its path), move Chart to a lower layer (runs or core), or an AD letting compare import viz.types.

The frozen signatures of evaluate.evaluate (make_env, agents, team, player, train_seed, n_games, record) and agents.DQNAgent.__init__ (obs_shape, n_actions, params, exploration, seed, use_memory, use_target) have 7 parameters each, and ruff PLR0913 (tool.ruff.lint.pylint max-args = 5, CR-20) counts keyword-only ones too (checked with ruff 0.17.1: 'Too many arguments in function definition (7 > 5)'), so neither can be written as contracted and pass the gate. Fix: a build-setup exception (CONSTRAINTS.md Exceptions row plus per-file-ignores PLR0913 for src/rllab/evaluate/protocol.py and src/rllab/agents/dqn/agent.py), or a contract Revise that groups the options (e.g. an EvalOptions / DQN switches dataclass). Everything else in M1-T01 fits the bar (compare->viz already covered by EX-02).

agents.DQNAgent.__init__(obs_shape, n_actions, params, exploration, *, seed, use_memory=True, use_target=True) has 7 parameters, breaking CR-20's five-argument limit (ruff PLR0913, max-args=5; no suppression allowed). Same issue as the evaluate.evaluate escalation. Every other M1 contract signature fits (TabularAgent has exactly 5). Suggested fix: DQNAgent(team: TeamSpec, params: AgentParams, exploration: Exploration, *, seed: int, ablation: Literal['none', 'no_memory', 'no_target'] = 'none') -> 5 parameters (TeamSpec carries obs_shape and actions.n; ablation replaces the two switches, matching RunSettings.ablation). Alternative: keep obs_shape/n_actions and move use_memory/use_target into a frozen agents.DQNSwitches dataclass (still 6, so it would need TeamSpec too).

TC-12 and TC-13 assert internal numbers the frozen interface cannot expose. TC-12 expects Q(cell 8, right)=0.1 then Q(cell 7, right)=0.009 at 1e-12, but TabularAgent declares only __init__ plus the Agent protocol (act/learn/save/load); act returns argmax actions, not values, and the NPZ checkpoint has no declared key layout. TC-13 expects the exploration rate at steps 0/25000/50000/80000 at 1e-9, but no symbol returns a rate and the contract does not say what counts as a step (act or learn calls); sampling act frequencies cannot reach 1e-9. Proposed: add TabularAgent.values(obs: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray (per-action values for a (1, *obs_shape) observation) and a pure core.Exploration.rate(step: int) -> float (or TabularAgent.epsilon(step)), and state that a step is one learn call. The ABL-03 bullet is testable as-is.

The frozen envs.Snake stub (src/rllab/envs/snake.py) subclasses core.Env but never declares the Protocol attribute 'teams', so mypy strict treats Snake as abstract: 'Cannot instantiate abstract class "Snake" with abstract attribute "teams"'. train_reference must build Snake(view='compact', rewards=settings.rewards) (reference -> envs), so check.sh gate fails on mypy with no fix inside M1-T07's Writes short of a suppression. Fix: the interface declares 'teams: Mapping[str, TeamSpec]' on Snake (and Corridor, same defect, which M1-T04 make_env will hit). M1-T07's code and 16 unit tests are otherwise done and passing in this worktree (src/rllab/reference/train/__init__.py, adapter.py, tests/unit/rllab/test_train_reference.py).

M1-T20 acceptance cannot be tested from the frozen viz.Replay interface, which declares only __init__(game, *, fps), advance() -> int and show(). (1) Bullet 2 says space, right arrow and +/- call pause, advance and fps doubling/halving, but the interface exposes no key handler, no figure/canvas, no fps attribute and no paused state, so a test cannot send a key or observe its effect without guessing internals (pyplot global figure, attribute names). (2) TC-28 says frame i of the replay equals Snake.frame() after step i and the shown score and step match the recording, but nothing exposes the current frame index, the drawn frame, or the shown score/step text. Only the advance() return sequence (1..11 then 11 x4) is testable today. Proposed addition: public read-only state (index: int, fps: float, paused: bool), an on_key(key: str) -> None handler that the Matplotlib key_press_event delegates to, and a way to read the drawn frame/score/step (e.g. current() -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, float], int]) or an exposed figure attribute.

TC-14 expects exact tensor equality of the DQN target weights against their initial values (updates 1-4) and against the online weights (after update 5), and that with ablation='no_target' targets come from the online network. The frozen agents.DQNAgent interface exposes only act/learn/save/load: there is no declared accessor for the online or target network weights (or the targets computed during an update), and the checkpoint is only 'a PyTorch state dict' with no specified keys, so it does not say whether or where the target net is saved. Also, TC-14's input names a generator 'corridor_transitions' (30 transitions, seed 5) that no frozen symbol declares. Proposed: declare read-only properties on DQNAgent such as online_state() / target_state() -> dict[str, torch.Tensor] (or document the checkpoint keys 'online'/'target'), and either add the 30 corridor transitions to tests/fixtures/rllab/TC-14/input.json or declare the generator.

M1-T28 depends only on M1-T06; it should also depend on M1-T18 or the builder cannot turn these tests green.

M1-T29 acceptance cannot be tested from the frozen interface. TC-17 runs check_env on Snake(view='compact') through the AD-03 gymnasium adapter, but no adapter symbol is frozen (no tests/contracts/reference.<Adapter>/, none in the packet). The mapping bullet (every AgentParams/Exploration field -> SB3 DQN kwargs: learning_rate, gamma, batch_size, buffer_size, target_update_interval, learning_starts, policy_kwargs net_arch, exploration_initial_eps/final_eps, exploration_fraction=decay_steps/steps, train_freq=1, gradient_steps=1, max_grad_norm=10, Huber loss) needs a frozen pure function, e.g. reference.dqn_kwargs(settings: RunSettings) -> Mapping[str, object], plus the adapter, e.g. reference.GymAdapter(env: core.Env) (gymnasium.Env). train_reference(settings) -> RunRecord exposes neither; inspecting the checkpoint would assume an unfrozen SB3 zip format and need real training. Please freeze the adapter and the mapping function.

M1-T31 cannot score the reference: reference.ReferencePlayer is 'Used by: lab; PL-03, PL-04' but lab never builds it. lab.players.load_player calls lab.build.make_agent on a reference run folder, which raises ValueError("agent 'reference': not built from settings in this milestone") (reproduced: train settings/smoke-reference.toml --smoke, then 'python -m rllab.lab eval runs/smoke-reference-s0-... --smoke' exits 2). TC-27 (dqn-compact vs reference-compact) and the viz.Chart ladder case (three agents and the reference) both need it, and the fix is in src/rllab/lab/players.py or build.py, outside M1-T31's Writes (settings/**, reports/**, tests). Needs a task wiring ReferencePlayer into load_player (load the run's checkpoint.zip) before M1-T31. Two smaller issues for the same replan: (1) run_report writes report.md/ladder.png/ablations.png beside the spec, so reports/ladder.toml and reports/reference.toml (the TC-26/TC-27 fixture paths) and reports/smoke.toml overwrite each other's outputs in reports/; (2) runs/ is git-ignored per architecture and outside the Writes, so the model-eval intent tests in the gate can only read committed report outputs, not the runs; decide whether real run folders (checkpoints) are committed, e.g. under reports/runs/, or the tests read reports/ artifacts only.

TC-26 (tests/fixtures/rllab/TC-26/expected.json, 'at least one agent > scripted': true; spec EVAL-04) cannot be met by the real ladder within QR-01..QR-03. Evidence from real training (200 held-out games per seed): scripted scores 18.7 (seed 0). tabular-compact over many configs (gamma 0.9-0.99, death -1/-5/-10, lr 0.02-0.2, 0.3M-3M steps, 5 seeds each) averages 17.3-18.3 on validation seeds 10-14 (one lucky config hit 20.5 on seeds 0-4 but 18.25 on 10-14). dqn-compact (gamma 0.9, lr 1e-3, 300k) averages 18.9 on seeds 10-14; gamma 0.95/0.99 and death -10 variants 17.9-18.4. dqn-grid (AD-05 CNN) reaches 3.2 at 70k steps and 13.95 after 1M steps (42 min, near the QR-03 60-minute cap). With 1000 pooled games (std ~6.5) beating scripted after Holm over ~7 claims needs a gap of ~0.7, which no agent reaches; a direct policy search over the same 11-flag compact view reaches 29.6 vs scripted 17.7 on held-out seeds, so the bar is reachable in principle but not by the value learners under aliasing. Everything else holds on validation: every agent >> random, dqn-compact (18.9) not worse than scripted, dqn-compact vs reference-compact (19.0) passes REF-02/REF-03; TC-16 passes on real corridor runs (settings/corridor.toml, tests/unit/rllab/test_model_eval.py). Options: drop or restate EVAL-04 (e.g. stretch like EVAL-05), allow a larger step budget / rented hardware for dqn-grid (QR-05), or accept a failed EVAL-04 in the report. Separately: tests/intent/rllab/test_model_eval.py is in this task's Writes but path_guard blocks it as protected (CR-06), so the model-eval tests can only live in tests/unit/rllab/test_model_eval.py.
